title: Roasted Tofu Bowl
description: A simple and flavorful bowl filled with roasted tofu and mixed vegetables.
instructions: Cut tofu into 1-inch cubes and place on a parchment-lined baking sheet.
Drizzle olive oil over tofu and sprinkle with vegan bowl seasoning. Toss to coat.
Roast tofu in the oven for 20-25 minutes, or until golden brown.
Toss Brussels sprouts with olive oil, salt, and black pepper. Spread on a separate baking sheet.
Roast Brussels sprouts in the oven for 20-25 minutes, or until tender and caramelized.
Toss sweet potatoes with olive oil, salt, and black pepper. Spread on a separate baking sheet.
Roast sweet potatoes in the oven for 25-30 minutes, or until tender.
Toss carrots with olive oil, salt, and black pepper. Spread on a separate baking sheet.
Roast carrots in the oven for 20-25 minutes, or until tender.
Assemble the bowl by placing roasted tofu, Brussels sprouts, sweet potatoes, and carrots in a bowl. Serve hot.
